name: LaunchBrake
author: MuhammadArham
description: Live appblock state in the Omarchy bar: which apps are blocked, appblock's own enforcement label for each, and live countdowns for timed blocks and pending cooldown lifts. A display layer over `appblock list --json` - it never inspects shim files, blocklist files, or desktop entries.

barWidget.description: Shows blocked apps and their countdowns, read from `appblock list --json`

schema.label: appblock command
schema.description: Command or absolute path used to run appblock. The default resolves `appblock` on PATH.

schema.label: Poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read `appblock list --json`. Countdowns tick locally in between, so a long interval costs nothing in accuracy.

schema.label: Stay visible with nothing blocked
schema.description: Keep the widget in the bar showing a zero count, instead of hiding itself when nothing is blocked.

schema.label: Blocked icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown before the blocked count. A warning glyph replaces it automatically when appblock cannot be read.
